title: Amazon Kids Kindle Colorsoft 16GB (newest model), Thinner and lighter, 7" color display, Weeks of battery, Includes 1 year of books and Enchanted Woods cover
features: A complete bundle: Includes Amazon Kids Kindle Colorsoft with 7” display, 1-year Kids+ subscription and protective case.
Colorsoft display: Paper-like color brings covers, comics, and graphic novels to life, while staying glare-free in bright sunlight.

1-year Kids+ subscription included: Thousands of graphic novels, comics and illustrated chapter books for kids 6-12, including Big Nate, Catwad and Marvel. Renews automatically at the applicable rate. You can cancel anytime.
Adjustable warm light: Shift the front light from crisp white to warm amber. Bright by day, warm by night, and easy on the eyes either way.
Waterproof: For reading by the pool, at the beach, or in the bath.
Up to 8 weeks of battery: A single charge lasts for months, so the charger can stay in the drawer.
Distraction-free: Just read with no apps, videos, games, or notifications to pull kids away from their books.
